coverage_definition: Main Schemes 2-4 successful routes from known 9 and 6 to Uvarigrin and Calamistrin A. Explicit procedure stages include seven transparently inferred uncharacterized intermediate graphs; source conflicts remain pending review.

issues.detail: Seven internal graphs interpret explicit experimental transformations and are not separately drawn or characterized. No internal yield allocation from combined yields.
issues.subject: stages

issues.detail: Systematic headings specify E but drawings use wavy new alkene bonds. Primary graphs leave geometry unspecified; heading-derived E alternatives are retained separately.
Heading calls 14 a tridecan-1-ol; drawing, oxidation procedure and HRMS require the ketone. Graph follows ketone.
Main Scheme 4 specifies para-nitrobenzoic acid; SI specifies meta. Reagent and inferred ester provisionally follow SI.
issues.subject: E14

issues.detail: Main prose says tetrabutylammonium; main scheme and SI specify tetramethylammonium triacetoxyborohydride.
issues.subject: E05

issues.detail: Cyclization main 60 C versus SI 55 C; Grignard addition main -20 C versus SI -30 C. No reconciled numeric temperature asserted.
issues.subject: E02/E03

issues.detail: Some source mass/mmol pairs are inconsistent with molecular formula; no normalized stoichiometry inferred.
SI reports mp 70-72 C versus literature 96-98 C and optical rotation +14 versus +35. Preserve discrepancies; independent natural-product identity validation not asserted.
Known precursor preparation lies outside the article-drawn network; no complete synthesis from commercial starting materials claimed.
